name: human
why: Has no powers, so it is strictly below every other race.
fix: give Human a small perk, e.g. +10% XP gain or +1 heart

name: feline
why: Creeper immunity and silent steps help early; it does little against endgame threats.

name: merling
drawbacks: none on land beyond aquatic tag
why: Very strong in water and in ocean builds, but neutral in most land fights.

name: arachnae
why: Wall climbing, night vision, poison and web crowd control add up to a strong fighting kit.

name: dwarf
why: Pickaxe-free stone mining, faster mining and darkvision are a great start; the combat value is small.

name: wood_elf
why: Strong for bows and gets spell power, but Epic Fight melee takes the damage penalty.

name: Hobgoblin
why: Loot luck and lasting gold gear balance out a fragile body.

name: siren
why: Area pacify and villager favour are strong; the slow healing on land costs it in most fights.

name: Half-Ogre
drawbacks: eats constantly, unwieldy, bloodlust blurs vision
why: Extra health, a big axe bonus and immunity to poison and hunger make the best plain melee tank.
fix: Stocky +health halve (e.g. +6 HP -> +3 HP)

name: Sharkfolk
drawbacks: -3 hearts, no shield, Hunger on land
why: Losing 3 hearts, shields and hunger on land outweighs the bonus damage outside the water.
fix: Fragile -3 hearts -> -1 heart

name: kirin
why: Only gives jump mobility and has more drawbacks than upsides.
fix: remove Nine Lives (-1 heart) or add +10% move speed

name: Saurusfolk
why: Speed, damage and a pounce are solid in melee; the lower health limits it late.

name: Ratfolk
why: Faster attacks, climbing, night vision and more loot balance its 3 lost hearts.

name: shadow
drawbacks: -3 HP, no armour above iron, exposed by sun/moon
why: Invisibility is good early, but the iron armour cap ruins it at the endgame.
fix: let it wear diamond armour without being revealed, or raise the cap to diamond

name: sporeling
drawbacks: much more fire damage, less health
why: Immunity to wither, poison and hunger plus a poison AoE balance its fire weakness.

name: Stoneborn
why: +4 armour and no knockback are a strong melee base, and the speed loss is a fair price.

name: Infernal
drawbacks: villager prices much higher, iron golems hostile
why: Full fire immunity plus wither immunity trivialises the Nether, Ignis and wither threats late.
fix: fire immunity -> 75% fire damage reduction

name: Dryad
why: Faster crop growth is its only upside, against two real drawbacks.
fix: add +2 hearts in forests or 'regenerate on grass by day'

name: Orc
why: +30% Epic Fight stamina is strong for melee, offset by the mana and trade costs.

name: Kobold
why: Fire breath and doubled gem drops make up for a fragile body.

name: Revenant
drawbacks: healing hurts, Weakness II in sun, Smite
why: Undead ignore it, which is very strong, but the inverted healing and the sun weakness cost a lot.

name: Wolf-blooded
why: Night bonuses are fair against a day penalty; overall average.

name: Changeling
why: Stealth that breaks on any action helps little, and it has no stat bonus.
fix: drop Thin Mask or allow blending after 1.5 s

name: warrior
why: A small damage bonus that works with any weapon keeps it reliable at all stages.

name: archer
why: Accuracy and moving while drawing are solid for bows only.

name: rogue
why: Stealth is useful but slow to start and gives no damage.

name: beastmaster
why: Buffed pets help early but fall off against bosses.

name: Cavalry
why: Mounted combat is rare in Epic Fight, so it is mostly a horse-breeding perk.
fix: add +10% damage while mounted

name: Duelist
why: +10% damage on bosses and parry stamina scale nicely into the endgame.

name: Guardian
why: Cheaper guarding is good, and the aura only helps in multiplayer.

name: Skirmisher
why: Speed on hit and cheaper dodges suit the Epic Fight dodge play.

name: Crossbowman
why: Faster reload and piercing are a solid niche for crossbows.

name: Spearman
why: Reach and the charge bonus are good for spears only.

name: Monster Hunter
why: +15% damage to the most common mob types (undead and spiders) plus extra loot beats the other niche classes.
fix: Slayer 15% -> 10%

name: Bounty Hunter
why: Illagers are a small part of the threats; only the emeralds stay useful.
fix: raise Outlaw Hunter to 15% and include ravagers/vexes

name: Battle Mage
why: A single 10% mana discount with conditions is the weakest class kit.
fix: add +5% spell power after a melee hit

name: Sentinel
why: Free Resistance I (20% less damage) plus 20% less projectile damage is a large flat cut in damage taken.
fix: Hold the Line: Resistance I -> 10% damage reduction, or a 4 s delay

name: Paladin
why: Stronger healing and an undead bonus are steady and scale well.

name: Corsair
why: Boat combat is rare; the drowning buffer is minor.
fix: Boarding Fury also applies within 8 blocks of water, or add +5% damage

name: Zealot
why: A single small conditional stamina regen bonus.
fix: stamina regen 10% -> 20% and add +5% damage below half health

name: blacksmith
why: Buffed crafted gear and cheaper repairs pay off in the endgame.

name: cleric
why: Enchanting above vanilla caps plus stronger potions is the biggest endgame power of any job.
fix: limit Enchantment Mastery to +1 level over the cap, or remove it for modded enchants

name: cook
why: Better food helps early; it fades once food is solved.

name: farmer
why: Doubled harvests and bonemeal speed up the early food economy.

name: merchant
why: Villagers that never run out of stock give infinite trades (mending, emeralds, XP) late.
fix: add a restock cooldown instead of an infinite one (e.g. 2x normal restocks)

name: rancher
why: Twin births and extra drops are a decent food and leather source.

name: miner
why: Faster stone mining and no hunger from mining are strong early.

name: lumberjack
why: Whole-tree felling and more planks speed up all early building.

name: explorer
why: Free sprint costs and a starting kit make travel cheaper.

name: Alchemist
why: Longer buffs matter more with endgame potions.

name: Sailor
why: Breath and ship speed are rarely relevant.
fix: make breath 3x and add +10% swim speed

name: Fisher
why: Faster fishing with doubled catches is an okay food and loot source.

name: Bard
drawbacks: horn needs goat horns; XP needs group
why: Group buffs are good in multiplayer and weak solo.

name: Herbalist
why: Doubled flowers and longer stews are near-flavour.
fix: add bonus to bone-meal on flowers and 25% chance for double crop seeds, or longer potion effects from stews

name: Beekeeper
why: Bees rarely matter, and one extra comb is tiny.
fix: extra honeycomb -> 1-3, and honey bottles also give Regeneration I for 5 s

name: Gravedigger
why: Faster shovels and extra undead loot are a fair middle-of-the-road job.
